Ava (People Ops): Thanks for coming to the all-hands! Two quick follow-ups about hybrid/office travel and the Qs we saw — dropping answers here and will update the workstyle FAQ link.
Maya (CEO): big +1 to clarifying. Some teams already booking offsites — want the process smooth for orgs of any size.
Jon (Eng): Quick one — for team offsites can we pre-approve a single PO instead of individual reimbursements?
Ava (People Ops): Good Q. Short answer: yes for Dedicated offsites. If it's >$5k or vendor-involved, please route a PO through Finance (Liza) and cc people-ops. For smaller team retreats reimburse via Expensify.
Priya (Product): Are there per-person caps for hotel + meals on offsites? We want to plan within budget.
Liza (Finance): Per-person caps: hotel $250/night for US hubs, meals $70/day (these are default; exceptions allowed with manager + finance pre-approval). For international regions, use local caps in the FAQ.
Sam (Recruiter): Contractors — are they eligible for travel reimbursements for onsite interviews/offsites?
Ava (People Ops): Yes for contractors who've been on payroll > 3 months and approved by hiring manager. For interview travel, recruiting-owned budget covers candidate/agency travel, not contractor teammate travel unless pre-approved.
Jon (Eng): Thx. Also, how do we handle coworking days — can folks expense a coworking pass occasionally?
Liza (Finance): We allow coworking up to $25/day with proof of booking. Use expense category "Coworking" in Expensify and attach receipt.
Priya (Product): Visa letters — who issues those for international offsites?
Ava (People Ops): People Ops issues invitation/visa support letters. Fill this short form: https://intra.redwood/workstyle/visa-request and tag me. We aim to turnaround 5 business days.
OfficeBot: Note: new desk-reservation rules live Mon — reservation window now opens 14 days in advance.
Jon (Eng): Any change to hot-desk grace periods? sometimes we need same-day hub work.
Ava (People Ops): Same-day drop-ins still allowed up to hub capacity. If hub hits capacity, priority is assigned to reserved desks + leadership visits. Please use the app to check capacity before heading in.
Priya (Product): Budget owners — who signs off on offsite budgets under $5k?
Ava (People Ops): Manager + finance partner (auto-approve workflow in Concur/Expensify). For recurring retreats or multi-team events, loop in People Ops for coordination.
Liza (Finance): Reminder: attach itemized receipts. We cannot reimburse hand-written totals without itemization. Sample acceptable format for an airfare expense (copy into Expensify memo):
```
Expense: Flight (SFO -> SEA)
Airline: ExampleAir 273
Amount: $412.00
Purchase date: 2026-05-04
Policy code: OFFSITE-2026
Project tag: ENG-OFFSITE
```
Maya (CEO): A note from leadership — we want small, frequent org get-togethers prioritized over a single large annual party. So feel empowered to plan local meetups.
Sam (Recruiter): Re: travel bookings — is self-book allowed or must we use travel partner?
Liza (Finance): For flights under $800, self-booking ok if you use our preferred carriers and get coach economy. For >$800, email travel@redwood to route through our travel vendor for negotiated fares.
Jon (Eng): What about expense splitting when multiple people share a rental car or AirBnB? Any tips to avoid messy receipts?
Ava (People Ops): Best practice: one person books and pays, others file reimbursements with a short note: "Share — names: X, Y" + copy of the master receipt. Finance will reconcile.
Priya (Product): Any update on vendor visitor desk policy? We have a consultant coming for 2 weeks.
Ava (People Ops): Vendor/consultant access requires a sponsor and 1-week headcount notice. For >2 weeks, run a security review with Eng Security. Notify office@redwood for visitor badges.
Maya (CEO): Thanks all. People Ops + Finance to publish an updated one-pager (policy + checklist) by EOW. Leadership will drop a short blurb in next internal newsletter.
Ava (People Ops): I'll post the one-pager here when it's live: https://intra.redwood/workstyle/one-pager — and will pin this thread. If you still have micro-questions drop them here and we'll answer quickly :thumbsup:
